The z value roughly checks out. The difference is 0.4830 - 0.4824 = 0.0006. With noise sd 0.0070 for each of the two single runs, the standard error is 0.0070*sqrt(2) = 0.0099, which gives z ≈ 0.061. The harness's 0.056 fits once you allow for rounding of the reported losses (a difference of about 0.00055).
This gain is well below the noise level (one replicate each, about 0.09 sd). Rejecting is right, and the edit adds a little complexity for no measurable gain.
